displayName: SVG Find element IDs by rect

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'pictureObject' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'pictureObject' is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: pictureObject
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Field/variable reference (if '*' omitted)

params.name: x
params.description: Horizontal coordinate of top left corner of selection rectangle

params.name: y
params.description: Vertical coordinate of top left corner of selection rectangle

params.name: arrIDs
params.description: IDs of elements whose bounding rectangle intersects with the selection rectangle

overloads.semanticRole: Fills arrIDs with the ids of every SVG XML element whose bounding rectangle intersects the given selection rectangle in the designated SVG picture, returning True if at least one element was found.
